text: Introduction: I am Brijesh Kumar Chaturvedi and I did my degree In Mechanical Engineering from the Institute of Engineering and Technology in the year 1990. Presently, I am working as General Manager (Production) in one of the premier Public Sector Undertaking, Oil and Natural Gas Corporation Limited, at its Hazira Gas Processing Complex. During my stay in the Engineering College, I had lot of experience, wherein, as the mess secretary I found some students in a very pathetic condition, pleading for the NOC for getting the examination card. Probably now, they all must be placed at a very good position but, it would have been very hard for them during those days of duress, when it was hard for them and their families to pay the Fees of the Institute and the monthly Hostel Charges. I had been Merit Scholar through -out my life and had my education from a premier boarding school, a ll the expenses for my schooling were paid by the Government of India . Due to the financial condition of their families, few of the merit scholars from my schooling days, could not pursue the professional courses and had to satisfy themselves with the lesser education and settle in life to feed their families. I got financial help for my Engineering through the Merit Scholarship I received for the excellent grades in class 10th and 12th. I have a daughter, unfortunately, a Mongol Child, who could not pursue her studies. My wife is M Sc, M Phil, but probably the God wanted us to do something for the Society, in the form of extending financial help to the needy students, who are not getting any help from the Government or from any other source. This way, We may do our duty towards the education of my child. Way Ahead : As said earlier, I too belonged to a modest background and was fortunate that I could manage the ends meet with whatever were the available resources with me. Now, with the blessings of my parents and the elders, and grace of God, I find myself in a position to help at least one or two such meritorious economically weaker students, who are unable to concentrate in their studies because of the economic constraints. I therefore propose to initiate a scholarship, in the name of my Daughter , to the meritorious student, belonging to unreserved category, but belonging to economically weaker class. I request the help of the Institute in identifying and certifying the credentials of the student, qualifying for the Scholarship. I propose some parameters on which the candidate student would be evaluated for qualifying for the Scholarship. I propose Scholarship to one student per year, that is one student each for 1 st Year, 2nd Year, 3rd Year and 4 th Year and 01 scholarship to the PWD student from 04 years. This will make 05 scholarships of ` 35000.00 (Rupees Thirty Five Thousand) each. If there is no qualifying candidate from a particular year, the selection committee may at its discretion give the scholarship to most deserving candidate from any year. The Scholarship will be called “HARSHITA CHATURVEDI MERIT cum MEANS SCHOLARSHIP” CRITERIA FOR SELECTION OF STUDENT FOR SCHOLARSHIP : 1. THE STUDENT SHOULD BELONG TO ECONOMICALLY WEAKER SECTION FROM T HE UNRESERVED CLASS. 2. THE STUDENT HAS TO APPLY FRESH EVERY YEAR. 3. THE STUDENT SHOULD BE MERITORIOUS AND THE MARKS SHOULD NOT BE LESS THAN 75%. (or the equivalent CGPA) 4. IF THE MARKS ARE LESS THAN 75%, THE SCHOLARSHIP WILL BE STOPPED AND IT WILL BE AWARDED TO ANOTHER QUALIFYING STUDENT. 5. THE AMOUNT OF SCHOLARSHIP WOULD BE Rs 35 000.00 PER YEAR PER STUDENT. 01 SCHOLARSHIP FOR THE PWD STUDENT (TOTAL 0 5 SCHOLARSHIPS, ONE EACH FOR 1 ST ; 2 ND ;3RD AND 4 TH YEAR STUDENTS AND 01 FOR PWD STUDENT) 6.
